# Bonterra

> Bonterra provides comprehensive social good technology for nonprofits, foundations, corporations, and government agencies to manage fundraising, donor relationships, grantmaking, case management, and impact measurement.

Bonterra is an integrated platform offering specialized software solutions across multiple verticals including nonprofit CRM, fundraising, volunteer management, case management, and corporate social responsibility. The company serves organizations ranging from small nonprofits to Fortune 100 corporations seeking to maximize their social impact through technology.

## Nonprofit Solutions

- [EveryAction](https://www.bonterratech.com/product/everyaction): Nonprofit CRM for donor management, fundraising, and advocacy
- [Apricot Software](https://www.bonterratech.com/product/apricot): Case management for nonprofits with impact measurement
- [Network for Good](https://www.bonterratech.com/product/network-for-good): Fundraising platform for small and growing nonprofits
- [DonorDrive](https://www.bonterratech.com/product/donordrive): Peer-to-peer and event fundraising software for nonprofits
- [GiveGab](https://www.bonterratech.com/product/givegab): Giving Day software for 24-hour fundraising campaigns
- [Mobilize](https://www.bonterratech.com/product/mobilize): Volunteer and event management platform
- [Jumpstart](https://www.bonterratech.com/product/jumpstart): Nonprofit capacity building with coaching and technology
- [Nonprofit Software Solutions](https://www.bonterratech.com/product/nonprofits): Overview of Bonterra nonprofit solutions for fundraising and impact

## Foundation & Grantmaking Solutions

- [Grantmaker](https://www.bonterratech.com/product/grantmaking-software): Platform for efficient and transparent grantmaking
- [Foundation Management Software](https://www.bonterratech.com/product/foundations): Foundation management for grantmaking and collaboration
- [Grant Management Software](https://www.bonterratech.com/solutions/grant-management-software): Grant management software for corporate giving and nonprofit matching

## Corporate & Government Solutions

- [CyberGrants](https://www.bonterratech.com/product/cybergrants): CSR software for corporate social responsibility programs
- [Corporate Solutions](https://www.bonterratech.com/product/corporations): CSR solutions for corporate giving and employee volunteerism
- [Corporate Social Responsibility Software](https://www.bonterratech.com/solutions/csr-software): CSR software suite for corporate philanthropy and employee engagement
- [Employee Giving Software](https://www.bonterratech.com/solutions/employee-giving-software): Employee giving platform for corporate social responsibility programs
- [Government Case Management](https://www.bonterratech.com/product/apricot-for-government): Apricot case management for government agencies and public services
- [Government Solutions](https://www.bonterratech.com/product/government): Case management solutions for public sector agencies
